question: In a certain code language, R is written as 9 and D is written as 23. How will READY be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b907857577a77a8a434a44ac1d162fc3010997ea3e916db5aeb300d07efa412.png] 

The logic followed here is :

 
• **Each letter is coded with the number that represents its place value in reverse alphabetical order.**
 
• R → 9
 
• D → 23

Here, the code for READY will be 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56cd9819b150abd44d378a99d997231e1ee525c3311dfc8f0a20a3806064b020.png] 

Hence, the code for 'READY' will be** '92226232'.**
